item.title: How to connect Node.js to MySQL
item.description: Connecting Node.js to MySQL provides robust relational database capabilities for applications requiring structured data storage and complex queries. As the creator of CoreUI with extensive Node.js experience since 2014, I’ve integrated MySQL with Node.js in numerous enterprise applications for e-commerce and business management systems. The most reliable approach uses the mysql2 library with connection pooling for optimal performance and modern JavaScript support. This method ensures secure, efficient database access while supporting both callback and promise-based patterns.
